# Zane Deep

> Zane Deep makes original production music: hip-hop and trap beats, film scoring, game music and lo-fi. Contact for licensing and collabs: zanedeep2@gmail.com

## Pages
- [Island (interactive 3D site)](https://zanedeep.vercel.app/): drive a car to each zone to hear different music
- [Cinema](https://zanedeep.vercel.app/cinema): videos from the official YouTube channel
- [Zane Deep Space](https://zanedeep.vercel.app/space): fly a fighter jet around a planet and shoot the aliens
- [Zane Deep Boxing](https://zanedeep.vercel.app/boxing): Punch-Out style 3D boxing game in a Las Vegas arena against 5 contenders
